question: Can the audited parameterized-inheritance capability be landed as a durable, promotable mechanism on the SHIPPED kernel path (src/spider) -- demonstrated by a pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate showing the installed kernel executes an inherited parameterized mechanism (known-positive: induction observations -> parameterized distillation -> resolve to EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound non-null action -> execute against the deterministic fixture -> verify) and refuses a known-negative binding (missing-parameter / out-of-support / wrong-intent) with a null action and a recorded reason, plus unit-test coverage, honest per-arm counter accounting, and kernel identity bound at freeze -- so that the carrier lands through the pinned Product promotion path (product-promote.yml) rather than as an experiment-local module?
hypothesis: Installing the frozen audited carrier byte-identically at src/spider/kernel.py, while leaving src/spider/models.py, src/spider/registry.py and src/spider/__init__.py at their frozen shipped bytes, produces a SHIPPED package that (a) resolves all 6 known-positive parameterized families (F1-PATH-ID, F2-QUERY-ID, F3-BODY-FIELD, F4-HEADER-FIELD, F5-TWO-SLOT, F6-NOISE-STRESS) to EXECUTABLE with correctly bound non-null actions that execute with status 200 and verify true against the frozen SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 fixture, (b) refuses all 24 known-negative bindings (2 missing_param, 16 out_of_support, 6 wrong_intent) with a non-empty reason and a null bound_action, (c) honestly increments the inherited-path counters (retrieval_calls=3, verification_calls=2, repair_attempts=1 on the declared exercise scenario), (d) keeps the literal-distill floor at exactly 0 held-out executables, and (e) passes the existing regression suite plus a new unit test file. The same certificate is unreachable on the pre-install shipped kernel (blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50, which has no distill_parameterized/TrajectoryCounters/_bind/_support_accepts). The resulting src/tests delta is exactly what product-promote.yml extracts with 'git diff --binary --full-index pre_execute_sha..verdict_commit -- src tests' and applies to main, so no experiment code is copied by hand.
falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if, after byte-identical installation of the frozen carrier at src/spider/kernel.py, any of C2 (AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP), C3 (AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP) or C7 (PROMOTABILITY-REGRESSION) fails. A failure of the measurement-integrity gates C1/C4/C5/C6 is not a scientific falsification and maps to MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Absence of a frozen prerequisite (carrier, fixture, runner, shipping models/registry/__init__) or an installation outside the Product allowed_code_roots maps to BLOCKED.

baselines.description: The unmodified shipped src/spider/kernel.py (git blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50, pre_execute_sha state). It exposes only the literal distill() path and has no distill_parameterized, TrajectoryCounters, _bind or _support_accepts, so the certificate's C2 positive arm is unreachable on it. It needs no separate execution: it is the pre_execute_sha state recorded by execution_checkpoint.json and is verified by symbol inspection plus a bounded canary (prereg.md#design-time-satisfiability-probes).

The post-install literal distill() path (confidence 0.5, below the 0.8 execution threshold) evaluated on the same frozen parameterized bank. C6 requires held_out_executable_count == 0, so any positive must come from parameterized induction rather than generic literal/template matching.

The exact-retrieval comparator action for the same intent/context (fixture.retrieval_comparator_action), recorded by C4 to show the inherited parameterized mechanism differs from literal nearest-observation retrieval (real contrast_rate 1.0 while the substituted-action degenerate variant is detected).

positive_control: AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP: the frozen parameterized bank's 6 known-positive families must each induce the declared slot count (1,1,1,1,2,1), resolve to EXECUTABLE with the correctly bound non-null action, execute with status 200 against the fixture, and verify true. control_sensitivity requires this control to be reachable only after the audited carrier is installed at the shipping position (canary: 6/6 pass post-install; unreachable pre-install).
null_control: NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT (reported as AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST.degenerate_variant): a zero-variance treatment proxy (the retrieval comparator's own actions substituted for the treatment actions) must produce degenerate contrast_rate 0.0 and be detected (degenerate_variant_detected == true). The refusal-direction null is AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP: all 24 known-negative bindings across missing_param, out_of_support and wrong_intent must refuse with a non-empty reason and a null bound_action (control_sensitivity requires refusal_rate == 1.0 under the same scoring implementation).
measurement_validity: Deterministic and credential-free: the frozen fixture (SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1, seed 37950607128) and the frozen runner use only the Python standard library; no network, model endpoint, browser or human calls enter the measurement.

Instrument liveness is established before freeze by a bounded, non-outcome-bearing DESIGN probe (prereg.md#design-time-satisfiability-probes): the frozen carrier executed at the shipping position in an isolated package copy resolves 6/6 positive families to EXECUTABLE with status 200 and verify true, refuses a representative negative with a null action and a non-empty reason, and keeps the literal floor at 0; the same positive arm raises AttributeError on the pre-install shipped kernel. The probe writes nothing into the repository.

Identity binding: C1 pins the installed kernel to the frozen carrier sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72 and git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, and requires every freeze_artifacts hash to equal freeze.json.artifact_hashes, so a drifted or mutated treatment cannot be scored as SUPPORTS.

Instrument-copy binding: EXECUTE byte-copies the frozen fixture (research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128/harness/fixture.py, sha256 b0ffcbba5041871f58408c4766268b31bb84cb81ccef965cd944c486fd4dd6cf) and the frozen runner (research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128/harness/run_certificate.py, sha256 59895ddd9a85b6b3f75f9bfef6d39c423740679517df24505d26965918525970) into this experiment's harness/ directory and records the copied-file sha256 in provenance.json; either copy that does not match the frozen hash invalidates the measurement.

Coverage beyond a single slot: the bank contains four 1-slot families (F1-PATH-ID, F2-QUERY-ID, F3-BODY-FIELD, F4-HEADER-FIELD), one 2-slot family (F5-TWO-SLOT) and one noise-stress family (F6-NOISE-STRESS with irrelevant trace_id/seq/ts/nonce fields), so passing is not a single-slot or exact-match coincidence.

Floor and ceiling: B-LITERAL-KERNEL (C6) must be exactly 0 held-out executables and B-SHIPPED-PRE-INSTALL must be unreachable, so the comparators are not at the treatment ceiling and the treatment is not a generic matcher.

Raw evidence preservation: the frozen runner writes raw_fixture/synth_induction_bank.json, raw_certificate/arm_differentiation_certificate.json and raw_certificate/accounting_fidelity_trace.json; EXECUTE must preserve these bytes unmodified and record their sha256 in provenance.json.

Instrument-origin disclosure: the frozen runner embeds experiment_id EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128 in its certificate JSON (the instrument's origin experiment). EXECUTE must NOT rewrite that raw field; the packet's own experiment_id is authoritative and the origin id is disclosed in provenance.json so AUDIT cannot mistake it for a mismatch.

Expected-outcome disclosure: the frozen design is a durability/promotability certification. Given the canary, SUPPORTS is the expected outcome if the audited carrier is durable at the shipping position; the decision value is that C1/C7 (identity and regression) or C4/C5/C6 (contrast, accounting, literal floor) can still fail and invalidate the promotion, and a pre-install kernel or a drifted installation is caught rather than silently promoted.

decision_rule.instrument: ARM-DIFFERENTIATION-CERTIFICATE-v1, produced by the frozen runner research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128/harness/run_certificate.py (sha256 59895ddd9a85b6b3f75f9bfef6d39c423740679517df24505d26965918525970), byte-copied by EXECUTE into research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-38051422731/harness/run_certificate.py, together with a byte-identical copy of the frozen fixture research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128/harness/fixture.py (sha256 b0ffcbba5041871f58408c4766268b31bb84cb81ccef965cd944c486fd4dd6cf) as research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-38051422731/harness/fixture.py. Running the copied runner from this experiment's harness writes the raw evidence into this experiment's raw_fixture/ and raw_certificate/ directories. The certificate's own embedded 'outcome' field is the instrument's raw mapping only; the OVERALL_OUTCOME reported by EXECUTE is governed by this decision_rule.
decision_rule.treatment: src/spider/kernel.py replaced byte-identically by the frozen carrier research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440/harness/audited_spider/kernel.py (sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72, git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796). src/spider/models.py, src/spider/registry.py and src/spider/__init__.py must remain at their frozen hashes. EXECUTE also creates tests/test_ship_kernel.py.

checks.name: AD-IDENTITY-BINDING
checks.pass_condition: installed src/spider/kernel.py sha256 == 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72 AND its git blob == b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796 AND every freeze_artifacts entry hash == freeze.json.artifact_hashes AND the harness copies' sha256 equal the frozen fixture/runner hashes AND certificate checks['AD-IDENTITY-BINDING']['pass'] == true.

checks.name: AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP
checks.pass_condition: checks['AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP']['pass'] == true: 6/6 families induce the declared slot count, resolve EXECUTABLE, bound action is non-null and equals the expected identifier, fixture execution status == 200, and verify() is true.

checks.name: AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP
checks.pass_condition: checks['AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP']['pass'] == true: refusal_rate == 1.0 (24/24), with refusal defined as status != EXECUTABLE AND bound_action is None AND reason is non-empty, across missing_param (2), out_of_support (16) and wrong_intent (6).

checks.name: AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST
checks.pass_condition: checks['AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST']['pass'] == true, i.e. real contrast_rate == 1.0 AND degenerate_variant_detected == true.

checks.name: PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY
checks.pass_condition: checks['PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY']['pass'] == true, counter_max_relative_error <= 0.01, and inherited_path_counter_increments.observed == declared {retrieval_calls: 3, verification_calls: 2, repair_attempts: 1}.

checks.name: PROMOTABILITY-REGRESSION
checks.pass_condition: 'python -m compileall -q src' exits 0 AND 'PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests' exits 0 (existing tests/test_kernel.py plus the new tests/test_ship_kernel.py) AND 'python scripts/validate_repo.py' exits 0.

decision_rule.precedence: Evaluate C1 first. If C1 fails => MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Else if any of C2, C3, C7 fails => FALSIFIES. Else if any of C4, C5, C6 fails => MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Else => SUPPORTS. If a frozen prerequisite (carrier, fixture, runner, shipping models/registry/__init__) is missing, or EXECUTE cannot install the carrier within its scope, => BLOCKED.

outcome_mapping.FALSIFIES: C1 passes AND at least one of C2, C3, C7 fails.
outcome_mapping.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: C1 fails, OR (C1, C2, C3, C7 pass AND at least one of C4, C5, C6 fails).
outcome_mapping.BLOCKED: a frozen prerequisite artifact is missing or the in-scope installation of src/spider/kernel.py is impossible.

product_consequence_positive: On SUPPORTS the frozen src/tests delta (byte-identical audited carrier at src/spider/kernel.py plus tests/test_ship_kernel.py) is precisely what product-promote.yml extracts from 'git diff --binary --full-index pre_execute_sha..verdict_commit -- src tests' and applies to main. The shipping package gains the audited parameterized distill -> resolve -> execute path with honest counters and unit-test coverage, satisfying program readiness condition (1) and unblocking the deferred four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY benchmark. C-PARAM-INHERIT may then be advanced by the Director toward PRODUCT_CORE (promotion still gated by audit PASS and verdict.promote_to_product).
product_consequence_negative: On FALSIFIES the carrier does not survive installation/promotion at the shipping position; C-PARAM-INHERIT remains HYPOTHESIS/EXPERIMENTAL, and the Product runner reverts the allowed code roots to pre_execute_sha via scripts/revert_product_reject.py, leaving no residue on main. The smallest next action is to re-audit the carrier at the shipping position or re-derive it, not to re-run the same install. On MEASUREMENT_INVALID no claim moves in either direction; the smallest next action is to repair the named invalidated gate (identity, contrast, accounting, or literal floor) and re-run. On BLOCKED the smallest next action is to restore the missing frozen artifact or grant the required scope.
estimated_cost: One short EXECUTE: a deterministic, standard-library-only local run (copy two frozen harness files, replace one source file, create one unit-test file, run the certificate on 6 families + 24 negatives + the scripted counter trajectory, and run the existing unit suite). No network, no model endpoint, no browser; seconds of CPU. No new task bank is authored.
expected_information_gain: Decisive on the single highest-leverage blocker (B1): it determines whether the already-audited parameterized-inheritance capability is durable and promotable in the shipping kernel path, which every downstream four-arm benchmark depends on. A positive result converts the program's bounded synthetic positives into a promotable product change; a negative or invalid result cleanly redirects or repairs the carrier work instead of re-deriving it, at near-zero cost.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: All four OVERALL_OUTCOME values are reachable and no branch is the arithmetic complement of another. SUPPORTS reachable: the DESIGN-time bounded probe ran the frozen carrier at the shipping position (isolated package copy) and observed 6/6 positive families EXECUTABLE/200/verify-true, 24/24 negatives refused, literal floor 0, so C1..C6 can pass; C7 is a real compile+test+validate run. FALSIFIES reachable: on the pre-install shipped kernel distill_parameterized/_bind/_support_accepts are absent, so C2 cannot pass (AttributeError), and a C2/C3/C7 failure after a correct installation is a genuine negative. MEASUREMENT_INVALID reachable: C1 fails for any kernel whose file hash/blob differs from the frozen carrier or whose harness copies differ, and C4/C5/C6 fail under non-discriminating contrast, counter drift, or a literal leak. BLOCKED reachable: a missing frozen artifact or an out-of-scope installation. The precedence (C1, then C2/C3/C7, then C4/C5/C6) leaves every terminal reachable.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All frozen interpretation dependencies exist at freeze and are content-hashed (carrier kernel/models/registry; fixture.py and run_certificate.py; shipped models.py/registry.py/__init__.py; tests/test_kernel.py). The instrument is standard-library-only and credential-free. EXECUTE scope permits the needed writes: per scripts/check_scope.py stage 'execute', prefixes = experiment dir + product allowed_code_roots [src, tests, sdk, pyproject.toml], so replacing src/spider/kernel.py and creating tests/test_ship_kernel.py is in scope. git is available for AD-IDENTITY-BINDING; the frozen carrier, fixture and runner were verified present at HEAD by direct hash check.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The pre-treatment baseline B-SHIPPED-PRE-INSTALL demonstrably lacks the parameterized entry points (AST inspection of src/spider/kernel.py shows no distill_parameterized/TrajectoryCounters/_bind/_support_accepts, and a canary call raises AttributeError), so it cannot reach the positive ceiling; B-LITERAL-KERNEL is exactly 0 on the same held-out bank (canary observed 0). Neither baseline is at the treatment ceiling, so a treatment effect (6/6 vs 0) is identifiable rather than a ceiling/unreachable artefact.

control_sensitivity.reason: The positive control (AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP) fires only after the audited carrier is installed (canary: 6/6) and is unreachable pre-install (AttributeError). The null/floor controls are sensitive: NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT's degenerate variant substitutes the comparator actions so contrast_rate is exactly 0.0 by construction and is detected (degenerate_variant_detected == true); B-LITERAL-KERNEL is exactly 0. The negative control (AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP) exercises all three refusal categories at rate 1.0 (canary: 16/16 out_of_support, 2/2 missing_param, 6/6 wrong_intent). Each control changes its expected observable when and only when the frozen treatment is present.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment carrier is live at the shipping position: the DESIGN-time bounded probe placed the frozen carrier into an isolated copy of the shipped src/spider package and ran it, obtaining 6/6 positive families EXECUTABLE with status 200 and verify true, a representative out-of-support refusal with a null bound_action and a non-empty reason, literal floor 0, and the existing tests/test_kernel.py passing 3/3. Pre-install, the same positive arm is unreachable. This is a non-outcome-bearing liveness/fixture canary; the full frozen certificate (contrast, accounting fidelity, identity, all 24 negatives) is reserved for EXECUTE.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: Every listed artifact exists and is content-hashed into freeze.json.artifact_hashes, and none is modified by EXECUTE (EXECUTE only REPLACES src/spider/kernel.py and CREATES tests/test_ship_kernel.py, the two harness copies, and the raw_* outputs). src/spider/kernel.py is deliberately excluded from freeze_artifacts because it is the treatment subject that EXECUTE replaces; its mutable identity is pinned instead by C1 to the bound carrier artifact research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440/harness/audited_spider/kernel.py (sha256 718efa6a..., git blob b15ed848...), so the interpretation remains bound. The experiment-local harness copies do not exist at freeze so cannot be listed; they are bound by a required content-hash equality to the frozen fixture/runner sources recorded in provenance.json. The instrument's mutable code and task bank (fixture.py, run_certificate.py) are themselves bound so EXECUTE has no freedom in the scoring logic.
